extras: Self-described as a hackathon build (Gemma 4) with a separate hackathon/README covering setup, eval results, and demo assets. Roadmap items (MCP support, Anthropic native, audit log) are not yet implemented. Privacy section warns that note contents are sent to the configured endpoint and that the API key is stored in data.json and travels with synced .obsidian folders.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI agent that can act on the vault (read, edit, search notes) while letting users choose their own provider and API key.
